description_en: Starts a reverse task that is created by calling the CreateReverseDtsJob operation
description_zh: 调用StartReverseWriter接口启动CreateReverseDtsJob接口创建的反向任务
name: StartReverseWriter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task generated by calling the CreateReverseDtsJob operation
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The checkpoint of the incremental write module. The value is a UNIX timestamp.

Default value: the checkpoint that is automatically saved by DTS when the original task is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
指定增量写入模块的位点，格式为Unix时间戳。

默认为原任务停止时DTS自动保存的位点
parameters.name: check_point

parameters.example: 资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。
parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This is a global parameter and does not need to be passed in for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
